sample.list.name: sample.list
sample.list.description: Sample block macro: renders variadic children as an unordered list (<ul><li>…). Merge this file into your macro DB to enable the built-in list renderer.

sample.table.name: sample.table
sample.table.description: Sample block macro: renders variadic row children as a table. If the first child's kind is 'table-header' it becomes the <thead>, otherwise all rows render as body rows.

sample.centered.name: sample.centered
sample.centered.description: Sample block macro: renders variadic children horizontally centered in a block container.
